## Resumo
A warm, premium dark split contact page for an AI design-tool brand (Slate), modeled on the Linear 'Contact sales' layout but reskinned to a midnight-navy canvas with a warm cream/amber palette. The screen is a single full-bleed two-column contact section: a LEFT 'reasons to reach out' rail (an amber 'We reply within a day' status pill, a giant cream display headline 'Let's build something.' with an amber period, an intro line, and a three-row routed-reasons list with icon tiles for Talk to sales / Get support / Press & partners, plus a mailto fallback line) sitting beside a RIGHT elevated form card ('Tell us how we can help' with a paper-plane glyph, a Full name + Work email row, a What's-this-about + Team-size select row, a How-can-we-help textarea, an opt-in checkbox, and a chunky amber 'Send message' button), with a small encrypted-and-never-shared reassurance line under the card. A sticky blurred navy nav (an amber diamond logo tile + a 'Slate' wordmark, Library/Canvas/Pricing/Docs/Contact links, a Log in link and a cream 'Start free' pill) tops the page; a thin hairline trust strip ('Trusted by design teams shipping fast' + four icon brand marks) and a full four-column dark footer close it. The reusable signature is the warm-dark split-contact system: a navy canvas with a cream text family and ONE amber accent, an Inter-only type ramp with a very tight tracking display headline, subtle dot-grain + radial-glow texture, hairline cream/10 borders, and dark inset fields that focus to an amber ring. The mood is calm, confident, premium and human, never a generic support form.

## Estilo Visual
Design a warm, premium dark split contact page for an AI design-tool brand on a deep midnight-navy canvas (#0b1f3a) with a cream text family (#f4ecdf, stepped down with opacity to cream/65, /60, /55, /40) and EXACTLY ONE accent: warm amber/gold (#f0b429). Register a Tailwind theme of navy { DEFAULT #0b1f3a, 900 #081730, 800 #0b1f3a, 700 #102a4d, 600 #16365f }, cream { DEFAULT #f4ecdf, 200 #efe6d6, 400 #d8cdb8 }, amber { DEFAULT #f0b429, 600 #d99a16 } and letterSpacing.tightest = -0.045em. Use Inter only (weights 300-900). Make the headline the anchor: font-extrabold, tracking-tightest (-0.045em), leading-[0.98], a big clamp text-[44px] -> sm:text-[58px] -> lg:text-[64px], with one word/punctuation mark in amber (e.g. an amber period). Keep all borders hairline cream at low opacity (border-cream/10), lift the form card on a slightly darker navy-900/70 fill with a big soft ambient shadow (shadow-[0_30px_80px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)]) and rounded-2xl corners, and spend the single amber accent sparingly but consistently on the status-pill dot+text, the headline period, the icon-tile glyphs, the form glyph chip, the focus ring, the primary button and the mailto link. Add subtle physical texture, never loud: a .grain dot overlay (radial-gradient(rgba(244,236,223,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) 4px 4px) on the main, a .glow warm radial in the top-right behind the form (radial-gradient(60% 80% at 78% 12%, rgba(240,180,41,0.10), transparent 60%)), and a .hairline gradient rule for the trust divider. Style form fields as dark inset .field controls on bg #081730 with a 1px cream/12 border and cream text, placeholders in cream/.6, that on :focus drop the outline, turn the border amber, lift the fill to #0b1f3a and add an amber ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(240,180,41,0.18)); make selects appearance-none with a custom caret. Set status-pill/eyebrow text uppercase with wide tracking ([0.16em]/[0.18em]); body and labels in font-medium/regular cream opacities. Use rounded-xl on fields/tiles, rounded-2xl on the card, rounded-full on pills/buttons, and ::selection amber on navy. Use Iconify Phosphor icons. Mood: calm, premium, warm-dark, confident and human, never harsh, never a generic blue SaaS form.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky blurred navy nav
A sticky top-0 z-50 w-full header with a border-b border-cream/10 bottom hairline and a translucent blurred navy fill (bg-navy/85 backdrop-blur-xl). Inner row mx-auto flex h-[68px] max-w-[1180px] items-center justify-between px-6 (lg:px-8). LEFT: a logo link (flex items-center gap-2.5) = a grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-amber text-navy tile holding an Iconify Phosphor 'ph:diamonds-four-fill' glyph (width 18) with a warm amber drop shadow (shadow-[0_4px_18px_-4px_rgba(240,180,41,0.6)]), beside a text-[17px] font-extrabold tracking-tightest text-cream 'Slate' wordmark. CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex): five nav links 'Library' / 'Canvas' / 'Pricing' / 'Docs' / 'Contact' in text-[14px] font-medium text-cream/65 with hover:text-cream, the current 'Contact' link set font-semibold text-cream (full strength). RIGHT (flex items-center gap-3): a 'Log in' text link (hidden below sm, text-[14px] font-medium text-cream/70 hover:text-cream) and a 'Start free' primary pill (rounded-full bg-cream px-4 py-2 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-navy with hover:bg-amber).

### Contact section shell + status pill
A <main class='grain glow relative'> wrapper (a .grain dot overlay = radial-gradient(rgba(244,236,223,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) background-size 4px 4px, and a .glow warm radial = radial-gradient(60% 80% at 78% 12%, rgba(240,180,41,0.10), transparent 60%) behind the top-right). Inside, a <section> mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 (lg:px-8) pb-24 pt-20 (lg:pb-32 lg:pt-28). First, a mb-14 (lg:mb-20) STATUS PILL: an inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-amber/30 bg-amber/10 px-3 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-amber reading 'We reply within a day', led by a small amber dot (a h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber). Then the split grid: a grid grid-cols-1 gap-y-12 lg:grid-cols-[0.92fr_1.08fr] lg:gap-x-20 lg:gap-y-0 xl:gap-x-28 holding the LEFT reasons rail and the RIGHT form card.

### Left rail: headline, intro, reasons list, mailto
The LEFT column (a relative div). A DISPLAY HEADLINE h1, max-w-[8ch], font-extrabold leading-[0.98] tracking-tightest text-cream at text-[44px] -> sm:text-[58px] -> lg:text-[64px], reading 'Let's build' (line break) 'something' with a trailing PERIOD set in text-amber. Below it a mt-6 max-w-md text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-cream/55 intro: 'Pick the door that fits. Whatever you're after, a real human on the Slate team picks it up, no ticket maze.' Then a mt-12 REASONS LIST (a flex flex-col <ul>) of three routed reason rows; each row is a group relative -mx-3 flex items-start gap-4 rounded-xl px-3 py-6 with a top hairline (border-t border-cream/10; the last row border-y) and a hover:bg-cream/[0.03]. Each row leads with an ICON TILE: a mt-0.5 grid h-11 w-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-cream/10 bg-navy-700 text-amber tile (group-hover:border-amber/40) holding an Iconify Phosphor glyph (width 22). Row content (a min-w-0 div): a flex items-center gap-2 row with a text-[17px] font-semibold text-cream title and a small trailing 'ph:arrow-up-right-bold' (width 14, text-cream/30 group-hover:text-amber), then a mt-1 text-[14.5px] leading-relaxed text-cream/60 description. The three rows: (1) 'ph:handshake-bold' / 'Talk to sales' / 'Seats for the whole design team, volume credits, and a plan that scales with you.'; (2) 'ph:lifebuoy-bold' / 'Get support' / 'A prompt that won't render, a billing question, a bug. We'll sort it together.'; (3) 'ph:megaphone-bold' / 'Press & partners' / 'Story ideas, brand assets, or building something on top of the Slate canvas.' Close the rail with a mt-8 text-[14px] text-cream/60 MAILTO line: 'Prefer email? Reach us at' + a mailto:hey@slate.design link in font-medium text-amber underline decoration-amber/40 underline-offset-4 (hover:decoration-amber).

### Right column: the elevated form card
The RIGHT column (a relative div). The FORM CARD = a rounded-2xl border border-cream/10 bg-navy-900/70 p-7 (sm:p-9 lg:p-10) panel with a big soft ambient shadow shadow-[0_30px_80px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)]. Card header: a mb-7 flex items-center justify-between with a text-[22px] font-bold tracking-tight text-cream title 'Tell us how we can help' and a grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-amber/12 text-amber glyph chip holding 'ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill' (width 18). The FORM (a flex flex-col gap-5): (1) a grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 row with two fields, each a flex flex-col gap-2 of a text-[13px] font-medium text-cream/70 label + a .field input h-12 rounded-xl px-4 text-[15px]: 'Full name' (placeholder 'Ada Lovelace') and 'Work email' (type email, placeholder 'ada@studio.com'). (2) a grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 row with two SELECTS, each wrapped in a relative div with a .field select h-12 w-full rounded-xl px-4 pr-10 text-[15px] (appearance-none) and a pointer-events-none absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 'ph:caret-up-down-bold' (width 15, text-cream/40) caret: 'What's this about' (options Talk to sales / Get support / Press & partners / Something else) and 'Team size' (options Just me / 2-10 / 11-50 / 51-200 / 200+). (3) a flex flex-col gap-2 with a 'How can we help?' label + a .field textarea rows=5 resize-none rounded-xl px-4 py-3.5 text-[15px] leading-relaxed (placeholder 'Tell us what you're designing and where we fit in...'). (4) an opt-in checkbox label (flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 pt-1 text-[13px] text-cream/55) with an h-4 w-4 rounded border-cream/25 bg-navy-900 accent-amber checkbox + 'Send me the occasional product note. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.' (5) a 'Send message' BUTTON: a group mt-2 inline-flex h-13 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-amber px-6 py-3.5 text-[15px] font-bold text-navy with a warm amber glow shadow (shadow-[0_14px_40px_-12px_rgba(240,180,41,0.6)]), hover:bg-cream, and a trailing 'ph:arrow-right-bold' (width 17, group-hover:translate-x-0.5). Below the card, a mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-center text-[13px] text-cream/65 REASSURANCE line with a 'ph:lock-simple-bold' (width 14) glyph: 'Encrypted & never shared. We hate cold outreach too.'

### Hairline trust strip
After the contact section, a full-width .hairline rule (a linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(244,236,223,0.14), transparent) h-px w-full divider). Then a <section> mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 (lg:px-8) py-10: a flex flex-col items-center gap-6 sm:flex-row sm:justify-between row with a text-[13px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-cream/60 eyebrow 'Trusted by design teams shipping fast' and a flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-9 gap-y-4 text-cream/40 row of four icon BRAND MARKS, each a flex items-center gap-2 text-[15px] font-semibold of an Iconify Phosphor glyph (width 18) + a name: 'ph:cube-bold' Northwind, 'ph:planet-bold' Orbit, 'ph:lightning-bold' Voltage, 'ph:leaf-bold' Fernweh.

### Dark four-column footer
A <footer> with a border-t border-cream/10 top hairline and a bg-navy-900 fill. Inner mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 (lg:px-8) py-14. A column grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-10 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-[1.5fr_1fr_1fr_1fr]: (1) a col-span-2 sm:col-span-1 BRAND block = the same amber 'ph:diamonds-four-fill' logo tile + 'Slate' wordmark, then a mt-4 max-w-xs text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-cream/65 tagline 'The AI design agent that turns a prompt into shippable UI on an infinite canvas.'; (2-4) three LINK columns each with a mb-4 text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-cream/40 heading + a flex flex-col gap-3 text-[14px] text-cream/60 list (hover:text-cream): Product (Prompt Library / Canvas / Pricing), Company (About / Blog / Contact, with Contact at full cream), Connect (X (Twitter) / GitHub / Community). Close with a mt-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-cream/10 pt-7 text-[13px] text-cream/35 sm:flex-row BOTTOM BAR: a '(c) 2026 Slate Design, Inc.' copyright and a flex items-center gap-6 set of Privacy / Terms / Security links.

Asymmetric split contact grid: grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-[0.92fr_1.08fr] (the form column slightly wider) with lg:gap-x-20 / xl:gap-x-28, pairing a LEFT brand-voice + routed-reasons rail with a RIGHT elevated intake card; stacks to one column below lg with the form card dropping below the rail.

Keep all borders hairline cream at low opacity (border-cream/10), lift the form card on a slightly darker navy-900/70 fill with a big soft ambient shadow (shadow-[0_30px_80px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)]) and rounded-2xl corners, and spend the single amber accent sparingly but consistently on the status-pill dot+text, the headline period, the icon-tile glyphs, the form glyph chip, the focus ring, the primary button and the mailto link. Add subtle physical texture, never loud: a .grain dot overlay (radial-gradient(rgba(244,236,223,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) 4px 4px) on the main, a .glow warm radial in the top-right behind the form (radial-gradient(60% 80% at 78% 12%, rgba(240,180,41,0.10), transparent 60%)), and a .hairline gradient rule for the trust divider. Style form fields as dark inset .field controls on bg #081730 with a 1px cream/12 border and cream text, placeholders in cream/.6, that on :focus drop the outline, turn the border amber, lift the fill to #0b1f3a and add an amber ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(240,180,41,0.18)); make selects appearance-none with a custom caret. Set status-pill/eyebrow text uppercase with wide tracking ([0.16em]/[0.18em]); body and labels in font-medium/regular cream opacities. Use rounded-xl on fields/tiles, rounded-2xl on the card, rounded-full on pills/buttons, and ::selection amber on navy. Use Iconify Phosphor icons. Mood: calm, premium, warm-dark, confident and human, never harsh, never a generic blue SaaS form.
style.fonts: Inter only (Google Fonts, weights 300/400/500/600/700/800/900), mapped as Tailwind fontFamily.sans. The DISPLAY HEADLINE is the anchor: font-extrabold (800), tracking-tightest (letterSpacing -0.045em), leading-[0.98], a large responsive clamp text-[44px] -> sm:text-[58px] -> lg:text-[64px], max-w-[8ch] so it wraps to short stacked lines (with one mark, the period, set in amber). Card/section titles ('Tell us how we can help', 'Trusted by...') are font-bold (700) tracking-tight at text-[22px] / uppercase tracking-[0.18em] for the trust eyebrow. The status pill and section eyebrows are font-semibold UPPERCASE with wide tracking (tracking-[0.16em] on the pill, tracking-[0.18em] on the trust strip). Reason-row titles are font-semibold text-[17px]; field labels are font-medium text-[13px] cream/70; body/intro copy is font-normal/medium in stepped cream opacities (cream/55, /60, /65) at text-[14px]-[16px]; the primary button is font-bold text-[15px]; nav links are font-medium text-[14px], the wordmark font-extrabold tracking-tightest. Numerals and all UI run in Inter, no second family.
style.palette: navy #0b1f3a (the page canvas + body background; navy.900 #081730 = the form-card/field fill + footer; navy.700 #102a4d = the reason-icon-tile fill; navy.600 #16365f available as a lighter navy step), cream #f4ecdf (the primary text + the 'Start free' nav pill fill, stepped down via opacity for hierarchy: cream/70 labels, cream/65 nav links + footer body, cream/60 reason copy, cream/55 intro, cream/40 footer eyebrows, cream/10-/12 hairline borders), cream.200 #efe6d6 / cream.400 #d8cdb8 available as warm neutral steps (e.g. placeholder cream is rgba(216,205,184,0.6)), and amber #f0b429 (the single accent: the status-pill dot + uppercase text on an amber/10 fill with an amber/30 border, the headline period, the reason-tile + form glyph icons, the icon-tile hover border amber/40, the mailto link, the .field focus border + amber ring rgba(240,180,41,0.18), and the primary 'Send message' button on an amber glow shadow; amber.600 #d99a16 available as a darker step). No second accent hue, no gradients beyond the subtle .glow / .grain / .hairline textures. ::selection is amber #f0b429 background on navy #0b1f3a text.

layout_and_structure.description: A full-bleed warm-dark contact page, centered inside a max-w-[1180px] mx-auto px-6 (lg:px-8) container, stacked top to bottom as: (1) a sticky blurred navy nav, (2) THE CONTACT section as a two-column split (a LEFT 'reasons to reach out' rail beside a RIGHT elevated form card, on a grain+glow textured main), (3) a thin hairline trust strip, and (4) a full four-column dark footer. The defining structural move is the asymmetric split contact grid: grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-[0.92fr_1.08fr] (the form column slightly wider) with a generous lg:gap-x-20 / xl:gap-x-28, where the LEFT column carries the brand voice + reason routing and the RIGHT column carries the actual intake card. The left rail's reasons are a vertical list of icon-tile rows separated by hairline cream/10 top borders; the right card is a single lifted panel with a two-up name/email row, a two-up select row, a full-width textarea, a checkbox and a primary button. Everything reflows to a single column below lg (the form card drops below the reasons rail) with no horizontal overflow at 390px; the nav center links hide below md, the trust strip and footer collapse their columns responsively.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 w-full header with a border-b border-cream/10 bottom hairline and a translucent blurred navy fill (bg-navy/85 backdrop-blur-xl). Inner row mx-auto flex h-[68px] max-w-[1180px] items-center justify-between px-6 (lg:px-8). LEFT: a logo link (flex items-center gap-2.5) = a grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-amber text-navy tile holding an Iconify Phosphor 'ph:diamonds-four-fill' glyph (width 18) with a warm amber drop shadow (shadow-[0_4px_18px_-4px_rgba(240,180,41,0.6)]), beside a text-[17px] font-extrabold tracking-tightest text-cream 'Slate' wordmark. CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex): five nav links 'Library' / 'Canvas' / 'Pricing' / 'Docs' / 'Contact' in text-[14px] font-medium text-cream/65 with hover:text-cream, the current 'Contact' link set font-semibold text-cream (full strength). RIGHT (flex items-center gap-3): a 'Log in' text link (hidden below sm, text-[14px] font-medium text-cream/70 hover:text-cream) and a 'Start free' primary pill (rounded-full bg-cream px-4 py-2 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-navy with hover:bg-amber).

A <main class='grain glow relative'> wrapper (a .grain dot overlay = radial-gradient(rgba(244,236,223,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) background-size 4px 4px, and a .glow warm radial = radial-gradient(60% 80% at 78% 12%, rgba(240,180,41,0.10), transparent 60%) behind the top-right). Inside, a <section> mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 (lg:px-8) pb-24 pt-20 (lg:pb-32 lg:pt-28). First, a mb-14 (lg:mb-20) STATUS PILL: an inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-amber/30 bg-amber/10 px-3 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-amber reading 'We reply within a day', led by a small amber dot (a h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber). Then the split grid: a grid grid-cols-1 gap-y-12 lg:grid-cols-[0.92fr_1.08fr] lg:gap-x-20 lg:gap-y-0 xl:gap-x-28 holding the LEFT reasons rail and the RIGHT form card.

prompts.part: Left rail: headline, intro, reasons list, mailto
prompts.partPt: Left rail: headline, intro, reasons list, mailto
prompts.prompt: The LEFT column (a relative div). A DISPLAY HEADLINE h1, max-w-[8ch], font-extrabold leading-[0.98] tracking-tightest text-cream at text-[44px] -> sm:text-[58px] -> lg:text-[64px], reading 'Let's build' (line break) 'something' with a trailing PERIOD set in text-amber. Below it a mt-6 max-w-md text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-cream/55 intro: 'Pick the door that fits. Whatever you're after, a real human on the Slate team picks it up, no ticket maze.' Then a mt-12 REASONS LIST (a flex flex-col <ul>) of three routed reason rows; each row is a group relative -mx-3 flex items-start gap-4 rounded-xl px-3 py-6 with a top hairline (border-t border-cream/10; the last row border-y) and a hover:bg-cream/[0.03]. Each row leads with an ICON TILE: a mt-0.5 grid h-11 w-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-cream/10 bg-navy-700 text-amber tile (group-hover:border-amber/40) holding an Iconify Phosphor glyph (width 22). Row content (a min-w-0 div): a flex items-center gap-2 row with a text-[17px] font-semibold text-cream title and a small trailing 'ph:arrow-up-right-bold' (width 14, text-cream/30 group-hover:text-amber), then a mt-1 text-[14.5px] leading-relaxed text-cream/60 description. The three rows: (1) 'ph:handshake-bold' / 'Talk to sales' / 'Seats for the whole design team, volume credits, and a plan that scales with you.'; (2) 'ph:lifebuoy-bold' / 'Get support' / 'A prompt that won't render, a billing question, a bug. We'll sort it together.'; (3) 'ph:megaphone-bold' / 'Press & partners' / 'Story ideas, brand assets, or building something on top of the Slate canvas.' Close the rail with a mt-8 text-[14px] text-cream/60 MAILTO line: 'Prefer email? Reach us at' + a mailto:hey@slate.design link in font-medium text-amber underline decoration-amber/40 underline-offset-4 (hover:decoration-amber).

prompts.part: Right column: the elevated form card
prompts.partPt: Right column: the elevated form card
prompts.prompt: The RIGHT column (a relative div). The FORM CARD = a rounded-2xl border border-cream/10 bg-navy-900/70 p-7 (sm:p-9 lg:p-10) panel with a big soft ambient shadow shadow-[0_30px_80px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)]. Card header: a mb-7 flex items-center justify-between with a text-[22px] font-bold tracking-tight text-cream title 'Tell us how we can help' and a grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-amber/12 text-amber glyph chip holding 'ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill' (width 18). The FORM (a flex flex-col gap-5): (1) a grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 row with two fields, each a flex flex-col gap-2 of a text-[13px] font-medium text-cream/70 label + a .field input h-12 rounded-xl px-4 text-[15px]: 'Full name' (placeholder 'Ada Lovelace') and 'Work email' (type email, placeholder 'ada@studio.com'). (2) a grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 row with two SELECTS, each wrapped in a relative div with a .field select h-12 w-full rounded-xl px-4 pr-10 text-[15px] (appearance-none) and a pointer-events-none absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 'ph:caret-up-down-bold' (width 15, text-cream/40) caret: 'What's this about' (options Talk to sales / Get support / Press & partners / Something else) and 'Team size' (options Just me / 2-10 / 11-50 / 51-200 / 200+). (3) a flex flex-col gap-2 with a 'How can we help?' label + a .field textarea rows=5 resize-none rounded-xl px-4 py-3.5 text-[15px] leading-relaxed (placeholder 'Tell us what you're designing and where we fit in...'). (4) an opt-in checkbox label (flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 pt-1 text-[13px] text-cream/55) with an h-4 w-4 rounded border-cream/25 bg-navy-900 accent-amber checkbox + 'Send me the occasional product note. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.' (5) a 'Send message' BUTTON: a group mt-2 inline-flex h-13 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-amber px-6 py-3.5 text-[15px] font-bold text-navy with a warm amber glow shadow (shadow-[0_14px_40px_-12px_rgba(240,180,41,0.6)]), hover:bg-cream, and a trailing 'ph:arrow-right-bold' (width 17, group-hover:translate-x-0.5). Below the card, a mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-center text-[13px] text-cream/65 REASSURANCE line with a 'ph:lock-simple-bold' (width 14) glyph: 'Encrypted & never shared. We hate cold outreach too.'

After the contact section, a full-width .hairline rule (a linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(244,236,223,0.14), transparent) h-px w-full divider). Then a <section> mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 (lg:px-8) py-10: a flex flex-col items-center gap-6 sm:flex-row sm:justify-between row with a text-[13px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-cream/60 eyebrow 'Trusted by design teams shipping fast' and a flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-9 gap-y-4 text-cream/40 row of four icon BRAND MARKS, each a flex items-center gap-2 text-[15px] font-semibold of an Iconify Phosphor glyph (width 18) + a name: 'ph:cube-bold' Northwind, 'ph:planet-bold' Orbit, 'ph:lightning-bold' Voltage, 'ph:leaf-bold' Fernweh.

A <footer> with a border-t border-cream/10 top hairline and a bg-navy-900 fill. Inner mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 (lg:px-8) py-14. A column grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-10 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-[1.5fr_1fr_1fr_1fr]: (1) a col-span-2 sm:col-span-1 BRAND block = the same amber 'ph:diamonds-four-fill' logo tile + 'Slate' wordmark, then a mt-4 max-w-xs text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-cream/65 tagline 'The AI design agent that turns a prompt into shippable UI on an infinite canvas.'; (2-4) three LINK columns each with a mb-4 text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-cream/40 heading + a flex flex-col gap-3 text-[14px] text-cream/60 list (hover:text-cream): Product (Prompt Library / Canvas / Pricing), Company (About / Blog / Contact, with Contact at full cream), Connect (X (Twitter) / GitHub / Community). Close with a mt-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-cream/10 pt-7 text-[13px] text-cream/35 sm:flex-row BOTTOM BAR: a '(c) 2026 Slate Design, Inc.' copyright and a flex items-center gap-6 set of Privacy / Terms / Security links.

special_ui_components.prompt: Asymmetric split contact grid: grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-[0.92fr_1.08fr] (the form column slightly wider) with lg:gap-x-20 / xl:gap-x-28, pairing a LEFT brand-voice + routed-reasons rail with a RIGHT elevated intake card; stacks to one column below lg with the form card dropping below the rail.

Routed-reasons list: a vertical <ul> of three rows separated by hairline cream/10 top borders (the last border-y), each a group row leading with a rounded-xl border-cream/10 bg-navy-700 text-amber icon tile (group-hover:border-amber/40) beside a font-semibold title with a trailing ph:arrow-up-right-bold (cream/30 -> amber on hover) and a cream/60 description; whole row has hover:bg-cream/[0.03].

Elevated form card: a rounded-2xl border-cream/10 bg-navy-900/70 panel lifted off the page with a big soft ambient shadow shadow-[0_30px_80px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)], a header with a title + an amber/12 paper-plane glyph chip, and a stacked form (a two-up name/email row, a two-up select row, a textarea, a checkbox, a primary button).

Dark inset .field controls with an amber focus ring: inputs/selects/textarea on bg #081730 with a 1px cream/12 border and cream text, placeholders cream/.6, that on :focus drop outline, turn the border amber, lift the fill to #0b1f3a and add box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(240,180,41,0.18); selects are appearance-none with a custom ph:caret-up-down-bold caret pinned right.

Tight-tracking display headline with a single amber mark: an h1 font-extrabold tracking-tightest (-0.045em) leading-[0.98] max-w-[8ch] at text-[44px] -> sm:text-[58px] -> lg:text-[64px] ('Let's build / something') with only the trailing period set in text-amber as the lone color hit.
Amber status pill: an inline-flex rounded-full border-amber/30 bg-amber/10 px-3 py-1 uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-amber 'We reply within a day' pill led by a small h-1.5 w-1.5 amber dot.

Subtle texture layer: a .grain dot overlay (radial-gradient(rgba(244,236,223,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) at 4px 4px) on the main, a .glow warm radial (radial-gradient(60% 80% at 78% 12%, rgba(240,180,41,0.10), transparent 60%)) behind the top-right form, and a .hairline gradient rule (linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(244,236,223,0.14), transparent)) for the trust divider.

Sticky blurred navy nav: a sticky top-0 z-50 border-b-cream/10 bg-navy/85 backdrop-blur-xl bar with an amber ph:diamonds-four-fill logo tile (glow shadow) + a 'Slate' wordmark, five center links (the current 'Contact' at full cream), a 'Log in' link and a cream 'Start free' pill that turns amber on hover.

Amber primary button with a glow shadow: a rounded-xl bg-amber text-navy 'Send message' button carrying a warm amber glow shadow-[0_14px_40px_-12px_rgba(240,180,41,0.6)], a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges on group-hover, and a hover:bg-cream invert.

Hairline trust strip: a full-width gradient .hairline rule above a 'Trusted by design teams shipping fast' uppercase eyebrow beside four Iconify Phosphor icon+name brand marks (Northwind / Orbit / Voltage / Fernweh) at text-cream/40.

structured.special_notes: Keep the warm-dark split-contact system intact, it is the whole point: a deep midnight-navy canvas (#0b1f3a) with a cream text family (#f4ecdf, stepped down with OPACITY, never new hues: cream/70 labels, cream/65 nav+footer body, cream/60 reason copy, cream/55 intro, cream/40 eyebrows, cream/10-/12 hairline borders) and EXACTLY ONE accent, warm amber/gold (#f0b429). Register the full Tailwind theme (navy DEFAULT #0b1f3a / 900 #081730 / 800 #0b1f3a / 700 #102a4d / 600 #16365f; cream DEFAULT #f4ecdf / 200 #efe6d6 / 400 #d8cdb8; amber DEFAULT #f0b429 / 600 #d99a16; letterSpacing.tightest -0.045em) and use Inter only (300-900). Spend the amber sparingly but consistently: the status-pill dot+text, the headline period, the reason-tile + form glyphs, the icon-tile hover border (amber/40), the mailto link, the .field focus border + amber ring (rgba(240,180,41,0.18)) and the primary 'Send message' button (on its amber glow shadow). Do NOT add a second accent hue or any loud gradient; the only gradients are the subtle .grain dot overlay, the warm top-right .glow radial behind the form, and the .hairline trust rule. Keep the dark inset .field treatment (bg #081730, 1px cream/12 border, cream text, cream/.6 placeholders) with the amber focus signal (outline:none, border amber, fill lifts to #0b1f3a, box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(240,180,41,0.18)) and appearance-none selects with a custom ph:caret-up-down-bold caret. The headline must stay tight: font-extrabold, tracking-tightest (-0.045em), leading-[0.98], max-w-[8ch], text-[44px]->sm:text-[58px]->lg:text-[64px], with the trailing period the lone amber color hit. The structure is a single full-bleed contact page inside a max-w-[1180px] container: a sticky bg-navy/85 backdrop-blur-xl nav (an amber ph:diamonds-four-fill logo tile + a 'Slate' wordmark, Library/Canvas/Pricing/Docs/Contact links with the current Contact at full cream, a Log in link, a cream 'Start free' pill), THE CONTACT section (a grain+glow main holding the amber 'We reply within a day' status pill and a grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-[0.92fr_1.08fr] split: a LEFT rail with the headline + intro + a three-row routed-reasons list of bg-navy-700 amber icon tiles, hairline-separated, each with a trailing ph:arrow-up-right-bold + a description, plus a mailto:hey@slate.design line; and a RIGHT rounded-2xl bg-navy-900/70 FORM CARD with a header + paper-plane glyph chip, a Full name + Work email row, a What's-this-about + Team-size select row, a How-can-we-help textarea, an opt-in checkbox and an amber 'Send message' button, with an 'Encrypted & never shared' reassurance line below), a .hairline TRUST STRIP ('Trusted by design teams shipping fast' + four Iconify brand marks), and a bg-navy-900 four-column FOOTER (a Slate brand block + Product/Company/Connect link columns + a bottom bar). Everything must reflow cleanly: the split grid stacks to one column below lg (the form card drops below the reasons rail), the name/email and select rows collapse from sm:grid-cols-2 to single-column below sm, the nav center links hide below md, the trust strip goes flex-col below sm, the footer columns collapse (grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-3 -> lg four columns) and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:diamonds-four-fill, ph:handshake-bold, ph:lifebuoy-bold, ph:megaphone-bold, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, ph:caret-up-down-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:lock-simple-bold, ph:cube-bold, ph:planet-bold, ph:lightning-bold, ph:leaf-bold). Copy is warm, confident and human with zero em-dashes ('Let's build something.', 'Pick the door that fits.', 'no ticket maze', 'We'll sort it together.', 'We hate cold outreach too.'). Set ::selection to amber #f0b429 background on navy #0b1f3a text.
